audit.whatIsWrong: Chomp is credited with healing in two places: spikes[0] "gives him a mini-heal on every bite" and whys[0] "Trundle's Chomp sustain".
audit.why: Chomp does damage, a brief slow and an attack-damage sap. It has no heal. Trundle's healing is King's Tribute (P), which fires when a unit dies near him, and Frozen Domain (W), which raises healing received. The distinction changes the play: the sustain is tied to the wave dying next to him, so trading away from a dying wave denies it — advice that is impossible to reach from the current text.
audit.corrected: Re-attributed the healing and rewrote spikes[0] and early around denying King's Tribute.
sources: champ-data/_kits/trundle.json (P King's Tribute; Q Chomp; W Frozen Domain)

audit.whatIsWrong: early says "his passive gives him movespeed and healing on nearby minions/champs".
audit.why: The movement speed is Frozen Domain (W), a placed zone on an 18-second rank-1 cooldown, not the passive. And King's Tribute heals on units dying near him, not on units being near him. As written it describes a permanent aura that does not exist and gives the player nothing to play around.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chomp's attack-damage sap is treated as a real cost in whys[1] ("His Q AD-shred and heal keep winning short L2 trades") and mid ("Chomp lowers your AD every trade").
audit.why: Zac's damage is Unstable Matter, a percentage of the target's maximum health dealt as magic. Trundle's AD sap is close to worthless against him. Two fields treat Trundle's signature debuff as though it decides the trade when it barely applies.
audit.corrected: Stated plainly in whys[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content level chart gives Trundle 6 of 7 stages while Zac wins 57.53% — the strongest Zac win rate in my slice. The full layer already reads Trundle/Skill/Zac/Zac/Trundle/Zac/Zac.
audit.why: The two layers disagree and the content one contradicts the data by the widest margin of any matchup I audited.
audit.corrected: Aligned the content chart to the full layer exactly: Trundle at level 1 and level 6 (Subjugate), Zac everywhere else.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags "NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere". Confirmed — Subjugate is described as dangerous with no number, and Pillar of Ice has none either.
audit.why: Chomp at 3.5 seconds flat is not waitable, so the punishable cooldowns are Pillar of Ice (21s at rank 1) and Subjugate (120s at rank 1). Pillar is the one that actually stops a slingshot, which makes it the engage gate.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the wait-then-engage rule added to mid, spikes[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Pillar of Ice creating impassable terrain that cuts the slingshot angle is already stated in mid and spikes[3], and Subjugate stealing health/armour/MR from the biggest stat-line on the map is correctly identified as the level-6 threat. Both are right and I left the substance alone.

edits.before: Trundle's Chomp sustain and passive healing beat your L1 pokes.
edits.after: Chomp is 3.5s flat and out-trades any L1 poke Zac can offer.

edits.before: His Q AD-shred and heal keep winning short L2 trades.
edits.after: At 2 his AD-shred barely dents Zac's ability damage.

edits.before: At 3 he adds Pillar of Ice to wall off your engage.
edits.after: At 3 Zac's W %HP chip beats Trundle's flat bites.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 his sustained duel and shred still outpace your W.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 blobs plus anti-heal outlast his duel damage.

edits.before: First item he still out-duels you 1v1 in the sidelane.
edits.after: First item, Heartsteel HP outgrows his single-target kit.

edits.before: Trundle's Chomp (Q) shaves your AD and gives him a mini-heal on every bite, so trading blindly with Unstable Matter (W) just feeds his sustain — only W when he's already committed to a minion and can't answer.
edits.after: Chomp (Q) is 3.5s and saps AD — which barely touches Zac, whose damage is ability magic. It doesn't heal him either: the sustain is King's Tribute (P) firing as units die near him, so trade away from a dying wave.

edits.before: Subjugate (R) drains a huge chunk of your bonus health and resistances, and since Zac is a big-stat tank you're the perfect victim; never fight him 6+ near his ult without your jungler.
edits.after: Subjugate (R) steals a share of your health, armour and MR and doubles it over 4s — as the biggest stat-line around you are the perfect victim, so never duel while its 120s rank-1 cooldown is up.

edits.before: Bite you with Chomp mid-trade to sap your AD and heal
edits.after: Bite with Chomp mid-trade and heal off your dying wave

edits.before: Trundle's Chomp out-sustains your early Unstable Matter pokes and his passive gives him movespeed and healing on nearby minions/champs, so he wins prolonged L1-2 trades — last-hit safe and don't W into a full wave.
edits.after: Trundle out-trades you at 1-2, but get the source right: the move speed is Frozen Domain (W) and the healing is King's Tribute (P) as units die near him. Chomp only bites and saps AD, so last-hit safe.

edits.before: L3-6 is his strongest window: Chomp lowers your AD every trade, Pillar of Ice cuts off your Slingshot angle, and his ult at 6 melts your tanky stat-line, so play for scuttle/roam pressure rather than solo-killing him.
edits.after: L3-5 is actually yours: your W takes a percentage of his health while his AD shred does nothing to yours. The danger is Pillar of Ice (E) walling off your slingshot at 21s, and his ult at 6 melting your stat-line.

edits.before: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — Steals your stats. Respect it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — steals health, armour and MR, 120s at rank 1. Never duel while it is up. - Pillar of Ice (E): 21s at rank 1, and it walls your slingshot — engage once spent. - Your E: not for chip.

notes: suspectNames flags "Let's Bounce" in spikes[3] — false positive, the text reads "Let's Bounce!" already. spikes[3] and spikes[2] are accurate as written and I left them alone. _missing-interactions.json claims "Trundle bypasses stacking resistances (King's Tribute (P), Subjugate (R))" — Subjugate steals resistances rather than bypassing them, and King's Tribute is a heal with no resistance interaction at all, so I did not propagate that framing.
